tecfi-company.title: Tecfi S.p.A. — Fixing Systems
tecfi-company.text: Design, testing and certified production of fixing systems — watch the Tecfi company video.

heavy-duty-metallic.title: Heavy-duty metal anchors
heavy-duty-metallic.text: Drop-in and expansion anchors for cracked and non-cracked concrete. Safe, certified holding power for structural fixings.

chemical-fixings.title: Chemical anchoring systems
chemical-fixings.text: High-strength resins, threaded rods, sleeves and applicator guns — certified hold for cracked concrete, solid and hollow materials

roofing-fixing-systems.title: Roofing fixing systems
roofing-fixing-systems.text: Certified excellence, high performance and a wide selection

general-fasteners.title: General fasteners
general-fasteners.text: Threaded rods, bolts, nuts and washers in zinc-plated steel — everyday assemblies and connections of every kind

roofing-fixing-systems.label: Roofing fixing systems
roofing-fixing-systems.description: Professional fasteners for roofs — certified screws for every covering and supporting structure, saddle washers with foam or EPDM gaskets for a perfect seal, and accessories for safe, durable, weatherproof roofing systems.

renewable-energy-plants.label: Fixing systems for renewable energy plants
renewable-energy-plants.description: Fixing systems for photovoltaic and renewable energy plants — corrosion-resistant anchors and screws for mounting solar structures on any roof or ground support.

heavy-duty-metallic.label: Heavy duty metallic fixing systems
heavy-duty-metallic.description: Heavy-duty metallic anchors and concrete screws for structural fixings — high load capacity in cracked and non-cracked concrete with certified performance.

chemical-fixings.label: Chemical fixings and accessories
chemical-fixings.description: Chemical anchoring adhesives with mesh sleeves and applicator guns — complete kits for threaded rods and rebar in solid and hollow base materials.

scaffoldings-ropes-nets.label: Fixing systems for scaffoldings, ropes and nets
scaffoldings-ropes-nets.description: Fixings for scaffoldings, ropes and nets — eye screws, ring bolts and anchors for temporary structures, safety lines and nets.

windows-frames-facades.label: Windows, frames and façades
windows-frames-facades.description: Fixings for windows, frames and façades — frame anchors and screws for precise, durable installation on concrete, brick and hollow walls.

light-fixing.label: Light Fixing systems
light-fixing.description: Light fixing systems for fast, everyday installations — nylon plugs and screws for light loads on all common base materials.

drywall-hollow.label: Drywall and hollow fixing systems
drywall-hollow.description: Fixings for drywall and hollow walls — cavity anchors and insulation plugs for plasterboard, hollow blocks and thermal insulation.

wood.label: Fixing systems for wood
wood.description: Screws and fixings for timber construction — hardened wood screws for structural joints with fast driving and high pull-out resistance.

rivets.label: Rivets
rivets.description: Blind rivets for metal sheets and profiles — quick, vibration-resistant joints in aluminium, steel and mixed materials.

sealants-foams.label: Sealants and Foams
sealants-foams.description: Sealants and foams for joints and gaps — elastic sealing and PU foams for insulation, weatherproofing and acoustic comfort.

cable-plumbing.label: Cable and Plumbing Fixings
cable-plumbing.description: Cable and plumbing fixings — clips, saddles and clamps for neat, secure routing of pipes, cables and conduits.

general-fasteners.label: General fasteners
general-fasteners.description: General fasteners — threaded rods, bolts, nuts and washers in zinc-plated steel for assemblies and connections of every kind.

drills-bits-sockets.label: Drills, bits and sockets
drills-bits-sockets.description: Drills, bits and sockets — professional accessories for drilling and driving, matched to our screws and anchors.

inblister.label: inBlister
inblister.description: inBlister retail packs — handy ready-to-use fixing kits for DIY and small jobs, clearly labelled and easy to store.
